name: FULL ADHD - Täyttä elämää
source: An educational visual novel about ADHD. 20 year-old Eetu is starting a new life at university and has to manage all the new aspects that come with it; meeting new friends, finding an apartment, studying, dating and working a part-time job on top of all that. You have limited resources to spend on your executive functions, so choose your actions wisely.
translation: 一部关于多动症的教育视觉小说。20岁的Eetu正在大学开始新的生活，必须应对随之而来的所有新生活；结识新朋友、找公寓、学习、约会以及做兼职工作。你可用于执行职能的资源有限，因此请明智地选择你的行动。
